mode: synthetic isolated renderer; external network blocked; no real account writes
checks: catalog discovery opens fixed product classification context
official product columns retain order and labels while hidden, duplicate, wrong-product and unsafe routes are excluded
server product sub-board IDs are preserved exactly through independent pagination
rating star and owner filters use confirmed fields and restart pagination on changes and tab return
late rating responses cannot replace new filters or a different account and product
purchasable versions use the separate version operation and malformed reads remain retryable errors
explicitly empty server tabList does not synthesize official columns
sub-board read failures retain their error and retry the same exact board rather than another feed
sub-board page-two network retry retains page one and repeats exact failed cursors
sub-board page-two verification completion retries page two instead of restarting page one
product feed default/latest/hot sorting uses the confirmed listType and rejects late prior sort rows
product rating overview uses exact all/owner distributions, recent statistics and own review navigation
server rating sort labels and descriptors remain authoritative and sorting restarts exact page-one cursors
server rating sort and explicit star-owner filters stay separate confirmed contracts
rating sorted page-two NETWORK retries exact failed descriptor/cursors while retaining rows
rating sorted page-two VERIFY_REQUIRED retries exact failed descriptor/cursors while retaining rows
late sorted rating reads cannot overwrite newer filters, accounts or products
product media image/recommend/video filters play direct video and navigate exact original feeds
product media errors retry exact filters and delayed previous filter rows stay rejected
product parameters compare variants and another model, retaining differences
product wish/follow and purchased review use distinct interactions
product rating trend uses server periods and owner samples
application information, historical versions and star rating are reachable
application node discussion is a separate read entry with the confirmed default sort
application comments expose all three confirmed sorts and sort changes reset page and cursors
application comment page-two network retry retains page one and the exact failed request
application comment verification retries the same page-two sort and cursors
late application comment results cannot cross sort or account scope
application collection can be created and modified with confirmed removal
application collection creation uploads a local cover using only the album payload before explicit save
editing an application collection saves the uploaded cover with its existing ID and draft fields
invalid, empty and over-limit local covers and cancelled file selection preserve the existing cover and draft
failed cover upload preserves the old cover and draft while retry repeats exact bytes without saving partial state
cover verification keeps exact image payload and failed album save keeps the uploaded cover and draft
cancelling an in-flight cover or closing the editor rejects late uploads without losing the draft or saving
pending cover uploads cannot alter a different application collection or account
cancelled cover verification cannot replay an abandoned upload after its verification window completes
official accounts and activity details can be browsed
missing application collection details are unavailable rather than an empty successful list
picture tags remain a read-only paginated gallery
guest catalog actions open login and issue no write operation
